full_judgment: 3. The defendant Nos.2 contested the suit by filing written statement denying all the allegations contending that the suit land originally belonged to Sovaram Agarwal and his name was correctly recorded in S.A. khatian. That Sovaram Agarwal left Bangladesh for India and settled there. Consequently, the suit land was vested in the Government. The Government, taking over possession of the same, leased out a portion of it to the Bangladesh Reshom Board. The Union Land Office and cluster villages are situated in some portions of the suit land and rest portion has been leased out to the different persons. The plaintiff has had no right, title and possession in the suit land. The suit should be dismissed.
